술.e: General word for any alcohol. 술집 = bar.
술.t: With elders, hold your glass with two hands and turn your head slightly away to drink.

터미널.ex: 고속버스 터미널에서 부산 가는 버스를 탔어요.
터미널.x: I took a bus to Busan from the express bus terminal.
터미널.e: From English 'terminal'; on its own it usually means a bus terminal.

기념품.x: I bought a souvenir for my friend at the airport.

풍경.x: The scenery outside the train window was as pretty as a picture.
풍경.t: 경치 is a view you admire; 풍경 is broader — any scene or landscape, also in art.

보고서.ex: 내일까지 보고서를 써서 부장님께 드려야 해요.
보고서.x: I have to write the report and give it to the manager by tomorrow.
보고서.t: Use 보고서를 쓰다 (write) and 보고서를 내다/제출하다 (hand in).

선.x: Try drawing a straight line on the paper.
선.e: Homonym: 선 also means 'goodness' and a matchmaking date (선을 보다).
선.t: 선을 넘다 'to cross the line' means to go too far, just like in English.

성당.x: I go to Catholic church with my family every Sunday.
성당.t: 성당 is a Catholic church; a Protestant church is 교회, a key difference in Korea.

뮤지컬.ex: 어제 친구와 같이 뮤지컬을 봤는데 정말 재미있었어요.
뮤지컬.x: I saw a musical with a friend yesterday, and it was really fun.

인터뷰.ex: 그 배우는 인터뷰에서 새 영화에 대해 이야기했어요.
인터뷰.x: The actor talked about the new movie in an interview.
인터뷰.t: For job interviews, Koreans usually say 면접; 인터뷰 is mostly for media interviews.

훔치다.e: Homonym warning: also 'to wipe quickly', as in 눈물을 훔치다 (wipe away tears).
훔치다.t: 훔쳐 가다 (steal and take away) is the most natural way to say something got stolen.

뻔하다.x: That movie's ending was way too predictable.
뻔하다.e: Don't confuse with -ㄹ 뻔하다 'almost did': 넘어질 뻔했어요 = I almost fell.
뻔하다.t: -ㄹ 게 뻔하다 means 'it's obvious that...', e.g. 늦을 게 뻔해요 (he's obviously going to be late).

공익.ex: 공익을 위해 개인의 자유를 제한할 수도 있어요.
공익.x: Personal freedom may sometimes be limited for the public good.

연주회.ex: 다음 주에 동생의 피아노 연주회가 있어요.
연주회.x: My younger sibling has a piano recital next week.
연주회.t: 연주회 is for instrumental or classical music; pop concerts are usually 콘서트.

산사태.x: A landslide caused by the heavy rain blocked the road.
산사태.t: Use it with 나다 or 일어나다: 산사태가 나다 = a landslide happens.

철저히.forms: 철저히 + verb: 철저히 준비하다, 철저히 조사하다
철저히.x: I prepared thoroughly for the interview.
철저히.t: Pronounced [철쩌히] — tensing after ㄹ in Sino-Korean words.

조르다.forms: 졸라요 · 졸랐어요 · 조를 거예요 · 조르세요 (르 irregular)
조르다.m: to pester, beg, nag (for); to tighten, squeeze
조르다.ex: 아이가 장난감을 사 달라고 계속 졸랐어요.
조르다.x: The child kept begging me to buy him a toy.
조르다.t: Often used with -아/어 달라고 조르다: 'to beg someone to do something'.

묵직하다.x: The bag is heavier than I expected.
묵직하다.e: Related to 무겁다 'heavy', with a solid, satisfying feel.
묵직하다.t: Pronounced [묵찌카다]; also figurative: 묵직한 목소리 (a deep voice), 묵직한 메시지.

눈에 띄다.forms: 눈에 띄어요 · 눈에 띄었어요 · 눈에 띄게 (noticeably)
눈에 띄다.m: to stand out, to be noticeable, to catch one's eye
눈에 띄다.ex: 빨간 코트를 입어서 사람들 사이에서 눈에 띄었어요.
눈에 띄다.x: She stood out in the crowd because she was wearing a red coat.
눈에 띄다.e: 띄다 is a contraction of 뜨이다, 'to come into view.'
눈에 띄다.t: A common spelling mistake: write 눈에 띄다, not 띠다; 띠다 means 'to have a tinge of.'

마음을 비우다.m: to let go of expectations or greed, to clear one's mind
마음을 비우다.x: I decided to let go and just wait for the results.
마음을 비우다.e: Literally 'to empty the heart' of desire and worry.

속을 썩이다.forms: 속을 썩여요 · 속을 썩였어요 · 속(이) 썩다 (to be distressed)
속을 썩이다.m: to cause someone worry or grief, to give someone a hard time
속을 썩이다.ex: 어렸을 때 부모님 속을 많이 썩였어요.
속을 썩이다.x: I gave my parents a lot of grief when I was young.
속을 썩이다.e: 속 = one's insides; 썩이다 = to make rot, as if worry rots your insides.
속을 썩이다.t: Don't confuse 썩이다 (to distress) with 썩히다 (to let rot or go to waste), a common spelling mix-up.

인절미.m: injeolmi (sticky rice cake coated in bean powder)
인절미.ex: 할머니가 직접 만든 인절미를 보내 주셨어요.
인절미.x: Grandma sent us injeolmi she made herself.
인절미.e: Origin uncertain; a popular legend says King Injo named it after a Mr. Im (임) who offered it to him.
인절미.t: Its roasted soybean powder flavor is also used in modern desserts like 인절미 빙수 and 인절미 토스트.

구설수.m: being the subject of gossip, bad talk; ill luck of gossip
구설수.ex: 그 정치인은 말실수로 또 구설수에 올랐어요.
구설수.x: That politician became the subject of gossip again because of a slip of the tongue.
구설수.e: Literally 'fortune of mouths and tongues' — a fortune-telling term for gossip luck.
구설수.t: Fixed pattern: 구설수에 오르다 (to become the talk of the town, in a bad way).

특집.x: The station prepared a Chuseok special.

탈바꿈하다.m: to transform completely, to undergo a makeover; to metamorphose
탈바꿈하다.ex: 낡은 공장이 멋진 복합 문화 공간으로 탈바꿈했어요.
탈바꿈하다.x: The old factory was transformed into a stylish cultural complex.
탈바꿈하다.e: Built from 탈 'form, mask' plus 바꿈 'changing'; also the biology word for metamorphosis.

촘촘히.ex: 이 옷은 바느질이 촘촘히 되어 있어요.
촘촘히.x: The stitching on these clothes is tight and close.

지지율.x: The president's approval rating fell from last month.
지지율.t: The suffix is -율 after a vowel or ㄴ (지지율, 비율) and -률 elsewhere (합격률).

형법.ex: 그 행위는 형법에 따라 처벌을 받을 수 있어요.
형법.x: That act can be punished under criminal law.
형법.t: Pronounced [형뻡] — the ㅂ in 법 is tensed in law names like 민법 [민뻡] too.

농경.ex: 인류는 농경을 시작하면서 한곳에 정착하게 되었습니다.
농경.x: When humans began farming, they came to settle in one place.

이비인후과.m: ENT (ear, nose and throat) clinic; otolaryngology
이비인후과.x: My throat kept hurting, so I went to an ENT clinic.
이비인후과.e: Literally 'ear-nose-throat-larynx department': a perfect English match, ENT.
이비인후과.t: Koreans often go straight to an 이비인후과 for colds, sore throats and sinus problems.

전전긍긍.ex: 시험 결과가 나올 때까지 일주일 내내 전전긍긍했어요.
전전긍긍.x: I was on tenterhooks all week until the exam results came out.
전전긍긍.e: Literally 'trembling and cautious', from the classic Chinese Book of Songs, which pictures someone who fears and trembles as if walking on thin ice.
전전긍긍.t: Usually 전전긍긍하다; often about worrying how to avoid a bad outcome: 들킬까 봐 전전긍긍하다.
rel: to be on pins and needles

썸네일.ex: 썸네일이 재미있어 보여서 영상을 눌러 봤어요.
썸네일.x: The thumbnail looked fun, so I clicked on the video.
썸네일.t: The official spelling is 섬네일 (English th is written ㅅ), but 썸네일 is what almost everyone writes and says.

벤처캐피털.x: We got investment from venture capital and grew the company.
벤처캐피털.e: From English 'venture capital'; often shortened to VC.

반감기.ex: 이 물질의 반감기는 약 오천 년입니다.
반감기.x: The half-life of this substance is about 5,000 years.

부영양화.ex: 생활 하수가 강으로 흘러들어 부영양화가 일어났어요.
부영양화.x: Household sewage flowed into the river and caused eutrophication.

개체수.m: population (number of individuals of a species)
개체수.ex: 보호 활동 덕분에 반달가슴곰의 개체수가 늘었어요.
개체수.x: Thanks to conservation efforts, the Asiatic black bear population has grown.

바래다.ex: 햇볕에 오래 둔 사진이 누렇게 바랬어요.
바래다.x: The photo left in the sun for a long time has faded to yellow.
바래다.e: Homonym warning: another 바래다 means 'to see someone off' (바래다주다).
바래다.t: Don't confuse with 바라다 'to hope': correct is 바라요 'I hope', though many people say 바래요.
